subject: Evaluation Asset Delivery — sandbox handoff & usage boundaries
messages:
From: Anita Kumar <anita.kumar@acme.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Diaz <carlos.diaz@acme.ai>
Date: 2025-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Eval assets for sandbox — ACME <> Redwood MAP

Hi Maya / Vivek,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the performance numbers look promising. We'd like to proceed with a limited eval in our sandbox. To keep things moving, can you provide: 
- A prompt pack (representative prompts + expected labels) we can run against the model
- ~2k anonymized test cases (customer-facing dialogues) for quality checks
- Instructions for ingesting assets into the Redwood sandbox (format, schemas, any pretokenization)

Constraints from our side: no production use, no redistribution outside the evaluation team, and we need to expire/delete the materials after the evaluation window. Our legal team also asked for basic watermarking/traceability recommendations so we can identify testcase leakage if it occurs.

If you can send a draft MAP that outlines timelines and ownership, we can review and propose a target close date. Proposed window: 2-week eval starting ~June 23.

Thanks,
Anita Kumar
Head of ML Ops, Acme AI

Attachments: none in this message
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Anita Kumar <anita.kumar@acme.ai>, Carlos Diaz <carlos.diaz@acme.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval assets for sandbox — ACME <> Redwood MAP

Hi Anita — great to hear. We're attaching a first-pass MAP and the prompt pack + ingestion notes. High-level approach: 

1) Asset set we can share now (attached): promptpack_v1.zip (sample prompts + expected outputs); a 2,000-row test CSV with PII removed and IDs replaced by hashed tokens; ingestion-sandbox-instructions.pdf.

2) Usage boundaries we propose (to be captured in the MAP):
- Evaluation-only license, no model fine-tuning with assets, no redistribution outside Acme's evaluation team
- Retention: assets available in Redwood sandbox for 45 days from delivery; auto-delete after expiry
- Derivative outputs: permitted for evaluation metrics only; external reporting must aggregate (no row-level reproduction)

3) Traceability recommendations: per-record hash + per-batch watermark header we add to delivered testcases; we can also embed a reversible marker in synthetic seeds if you want stronger traceability (we charge for custom transformations).

4) Operational steps / timeline (suggested):
- Tue 6/24: Redwood delivers assets to Acme sandbox and MAP-draft executed by project leads
- Wed 6/25—Fri 6/27: Acme runs smoke tests and initial quality check
- Mon 6/30: joint review call; decide production pilot or close

I've attached: MAP-draft-ACME-20250618.docx, acme_promptpack_v1.zip, ingestion-sandbox-instructions.pdf.

Questions for your legal: does Acme need a non-derivative clause explicitly prohibiting model-training on the assets, or is an evaluation-only clause sufficient?

—Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-draft-ACME-20250618.docx; acme_promptpack_v1.zip; ingestion-sandbox-instructions.pdf

Subject: Re: Eval assets for sandbox — ACME <> Redwood MAP

Thanks Maya — downloaded the pack and quick thumbs up on structure. A couple of asks from our side before sign: 

- Retention: can we tighten to 30 days instead of 45? Our privacy policy reviewers prefer shorter windows for third-party assets.
- Evidence: Acme needs a SOC2 extract for sandbox controls (just the relevant section) — can you point us to where we can pull this or provide a scanned excerpt?
- Usage clause: legal prefers a short non-training/derivative clause spelled out with an explicit prohibition on model re-training using the rows.

I'll loop legal (cc'd) to propose exact language. If we agree on those three things we can target sign-off by next Wednesday (6/25).

Regards,
Carlos
Product Ops, Acme AI

- Retention: we can accept 30 days instead of 45. We'll set the default delivery TTL to 30 days and confirm auto-delete in writing.
- SOC2 extract: Redwood can provide the sandbox controls excerpt; I'll have security attach the PDF by end of day tomorrow.
- Non-training clause: happy to add explicit language to the MAP: "Acme agrees not to use delivered assets to train, fine-tune, or otherwise update any model weights or parameter sets outside of Redwood-managed evaluation endpoints." Please ask your legal for any additional phrasing.

Next steps / timeline to close: 
- 6/19 EOD: Redwood provides SOC2 controls excerpt (lauren to confirm)

- 6/23: Assets delivered into the sandbox; evaluation window (30 days) begins
